tutorial.welcomeDesc: We'll show you the main features in 5 quick steps.
tutorial.step1Desc: Here you process sales. Search products by name or barcode, add them to cart and checkout.
tutorial.step2Desc: Manage your products: create, edit, adjust stock and view low stock alerts.
tutorial.step3Desc: Open the register with an initial amount before using POS. When closing, reconcile cash.
tutorial.step3Tip: Only one register can be open at a time
tutorial.step4Desc: View sales by period, top products and payment methods.
tutorial.step4Tip: Use quick filters for date range
tutorial.step5Desc: Configure business info, users, taxes and backup your data.
tutorial.step5Tip: Backup regularly to protect your data
